mostWorthwhile.text: Processing and exporting the collagen was the most worthwhile action: it connected protein production inside a cell to supporting fibers outside it.

leastWorthwhile.text: Adding the finished fibers to the wound felt like a predictable placement after the preceding construction, though it clearly showed where they helped.

surprise.text: The renewed barrier still has loosely arranged collagen underneath, so the tissue continues to remodel after the surface closes.

arbitrary.text: No action felt arbitrary. The menu supplied compatible partners, and each choice had a clear purpose in rebuilding support or closing the surface.

continue.text: I would probably continue: following collagen from instructions to fibers and then seeing the surface close made the connection between cellular work and tissue repair interesting, although several steps were predictable.
